metadata.pr_title: Add nodes for basic string operations
metadata.pr_description:
String nodes, requested in RFC https://github.com/Kosinkadink/rfcs/blob/main/rfcs/0000-corenodes.md#string-nodes
Designed nodes:
1. Concatenate, and input is: 
- string_a, 
- string_b 
- separator
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/894c0afc-664f-49a2-a0de-ed60c2aacfc5)
2. Substring, and input is:
- string
- start
- end
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1ab814a6-f360-43cb-86be-ac61486c9a78)

3. Length, and input is
- string
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb4f7413-2f59-4faf-aaa7-cc3b0fbf4322)

4. Case Converter, and input is
- string
- mode, with options are ["UPPERCASE", "lowercase", "Capitalize", "Title Case"]
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ba1041fd-40f5-4af0-a52b-c0df3ae3d3e4)

5. Trim, and input is
- string
- mode, with options are ["BOTH", "LEFT", "RIGHT"]
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6489d7d8-ab78-4e9e-b172-b4f7e3cbacb2)

6. Replace, and input is
- string
- find
- replace
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/997c09d6-75f2-4e71-90d5-6d0f77cfcb09)

7. Contains, and input is
- string
- substring
- case_sensitive
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e66adb5b-02de-4ba8-b848-f9f83215e694)

8. Compare, and input is
- string_a
- string_b
- mode, with options are ["StartsWith", "EndsWith", "Equal"]
- case_sensitive
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dd3b9ae-f3d8-41bc-90c2-8e459a923840)

9. Regex Match, and input is
- string
- regex_pattern
- case_insensitive
- multiline
- dotall
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a57ea778-009b-4b8e-94d0-e440c6ca235d)

10. Regex Extract, and input is
- string
- regex_pattern
- mode, with options are ["First Match", "All Matches", "First Group", "All Groups"]
- case_insensitive
- multiline
- dotall
- group_index
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b4d1fce8-f2a9-422d-8b62-9ac90d50060a)

intent_extractor.intent_summary: This PR adds a new set of string manipulation nodes to ComfyUI, implementing 10 distinct string operation nodes as requested in an RFC. The nodes cover concatenation, substring extraction, length calculation, case conversion, trimming, replacement, containment checking, comparison, regex matching, and regex extraction. The implementation is in a new file `comfy_extras/nodes_string.py` with all nodes categorized under `utils/string`. (Surfaces introduced in diff: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract.)
intent_extractor.non_goals: The PR does not appear to address performance optimization, internationalization beyond basic string operations, error handling for invalid indices or regex patterns, or integration with other node types beyond string inputs/outputs.

explorer_run.last_summary: Bootstrap exploration complete. Reviewed nodes_string.py and nodes.py diff. Identified 10 new string manipulation nodes with no obvious correctness bugs in the diff. Noted potential edge cases in StringSubstring (negative indices, out-of-bounds), CaseConverter/StringTrim (missing mode in else clause), and RegexExtract (group_index handling). All nodes have required inputs per schema, so null guards are not findings. No security or performance concerns visible. Ready for targeted review tasks.

draft_tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Basic String Operations (Concat, Substring, Length, Case)
draft_tasks.description: Audit StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, and CaseConverter. Verify branch exhaustiveness for CaseConverter modes (UPPERCASE, lowercase, etc.). Check StringSubstring for off-by-one or negative index risks and bounds handling. Ensure all paths return a consistent string type (no None leakage). Verify no implicit fall-through in if/elif chains. Do not review other classes. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

draft_tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Comparison and Transformation Operations (Trim, Replace, Contains, Compare)
draft_tasks.description: Audit StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, and StringCompare. Verify branch exhaustiveness for StringTrim modes (BOTH, LEFT, RIGHT) and StringCompare modes (StartsWith, EndsWith, Equal). Ensure StringReplace handles empty find/replace gracefully without crashing. Check StringContains case_sensitive logic consistency. Verify all paths return the declared types (string or boolean) and no implicit fall-through exists. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

draft_tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Regex Structured Extraction (Match, Extract)
draft_tasks.description: Audit RegexMatch and RegexExtract with focus on structured extraction correctness per in-function contract rules. Verify correct indexing into regex tuples and capture groups (no off-by-one errors). Check for safe aggregation before return (no stray None in join/format paths unless allowed). Ensure try/except blocks handle regex compilation or match errors gracefully. Verify discriminant/mode inputs are handled exhaustively. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

draft_tasks.title: Regex injection and pattern safety
draft_tasks.description: Review RegexMatch and RegexExtract for potential regex injection vulnerabilities. Check if user-provided patterns are sanitized or if they could lead to ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) attacks. Verify that capture group indices are validated before use.

draft_tasks.title: Regex compilation and caching optimization
draft_tasks.description: Audit RegexMatch and RegexExtract for repeated regex compilation. Check if patterns are compiled once and cached versus compiled on every invocation. Review string operations for unnecessary allocations or copying in hot paths.

draft_tasks.title: Error handling and user feedback
draft_tasks.description: Review all 10 entry points for consistent error handling. Check that invalid inputs, regex errors, and out-of-bounds conditions raise appropriate exceptions with clear messages rather than failing silently or with cryptic tracebacks.

draft_tasks.title: Structured extraction and aggregation
draft_tasks.description: Audit structured extraction and aggregation in changed handlers: correct index/slot into tuples/lists/rows (not only the first element); truthiness on empty group-like results vs full-match semantics; and join/format paths with no stray None unless allowed. Do not review any other class in the target file.

Consolidated structured extraction checks into the Regex task to align with in-function contract rules regarding tuple indexing and capture groups. Balanced coverage across logic, security, performance, and general specialties.

tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Basic String Operations (Concat, Substring, Length, Case)
tasks.description: Audit StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, and CaseConverter. Verify branch exhaustiveness for CaseConverter modes (UPPERCASE, lowercase, etc.). Check StringSubstring for off-by-one or negative index risks and bounds handling. Ensure all paths return a consistent string type (no None leakage). Verify no implicit fall-through in if/elif chains. Do not review other classes. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Comparison and Transformation Operations (Trim, Replace, Contains, Compare)
tasks.description: Audit StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, and StringCompare. Verify branch exhaustiveness for StringTrim modes (BOTH, LEFT, RIGHT) and StringCompare modes (StartsWith, EndsWith, Equal). Ensure StringReplace handles empty find/replace gracefully without crashing. Check StringContains case_sensitive logic consistency. Verify all paths return the declared types (string or boolean) and no implicit fall-through exists. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

tasks.title: Diff-local correctness: Regex Structured Extraction (Match, Extract)
tasks.description: Audit RegexMatch and RegexExtract with focus on structured extraction correctness per in-function contract rules. Verify correct indexing into regex tuples and capture groups (no off-by-one errors). Check for safe aggregation before return (no stray None in join/format paths unless allowed). Ensure try/except blocks handle regex compilation or match errors gracefully. Verify discriminant/mode inputs are handled exhaustively. Audit every changed entry point in: StringConcatenate, StringSubstring, StringLength, CaseConverter, StringTrim, StringReplace, StringContains, StringCompare, RegexMatch, RegexExtract. For each: branch exhaustiveness on mode/discriminant inputs, consistent return on all paths, correct indexing into structured results (e.g. regex tuples, capture groups), and safe aggregation before return.

tasks.title: Regex injection and pattern safety
tasks.description: Review RegexMatch and RegexExtract for potential regex injection vulnerabilities. Check if user-provided patterns are sanitized or if they could lead to ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) attacks. Verify that capture group indices are validated before use.

tasks.title: Regex compilation and caching optimization
tasks.description: Audit RegexMatch and RegexExtract for repeated regex compilation. Check if patterns are compiled once and cached versus compiled on every invocation. Review string operations for unnecessary allocations or copying in hot paths.

tasks.title: Error handling and user feedback
tasks.description: Review all 10 entry points for consistent error handling. Check that invalid inputs, regex errors, and out-of-bounds conditions raise appropriate exceptions with clear messages rather than failing silently or with cryptic tracebacks.

tasks.title: Structured extraction and aggregation
tasks.description: Audit structured extraction and aggregation in changed handlers: correct index/slot into tuples/lists/rows (not only the first element); truthiness on empty group-like results vs full-match semantics; and join/format paths with no stray None unless allowed. Do not review any other class in the target file.

Declared input contracts (upstream): Assume runtime inputs satisfy the framework's declared input schema for each entry point (e.g. plugin/node INPUT_TYPES, public API parameter types, protobuf/JSON schema required fields, OpenAPI required properties). Do not report missing null/None/empty guards for parameters that are required and non-optional in that schema. Treat absent null checks as a defect only when the input is explicitly optional (Optional, nullable, ANY/wildcard, or documented as accepting missing/absent values), or when the diff itself introduces nullable handling that implies such values can arrive.
In-function contracts (downstream of schema): Declared input schemas do not prove branch exhaustiveness or return-type correctness inside the handler. Missing else/return, implicit None when RETURN_TYPES or annotations promise a concrete type, wrong element from structured returns (regex tuples, ORM rows, JSON nodes), and None in aggregations (join, serializers) are in scope even when enums or COMBO lists document allowed values. Do not dismiss those solely because a UI or schema restricts inputs—use needs_verification only when the failure mode depends on undocumented runtime bypass (manual edits, schema drift). This rule does NOT override the upstream declared-input rule: do not report missing None/null guards on required, non-optional parameters solely because runtime might violate types.
